en.bdb: Pauri: I have all the 20 demerits

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰੁ ਹਉ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਮੰਦਾ ।
verses.translit_en: hau aparaadhee gunahagaar hau bemukh ma(n)dhaa |

en.bdb: I am a criminal, a sinner, evil and apostate.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੋਰੁ ਯਾਰੁ ਜੂਆਰਿ ਹਉ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜੋਹੰਦਾ ।
verses.translit_en: chor yaar jooaar hau par ghar joha(n)dhaa |

en.bdb: I am a thief, adulterer; gambler who always keeps his eye upon other's household.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਹਰਾਮਖੋਰੁ ਠਗੁ ਦੇਸ ਠਗੰਦਾ ।
verses.translit_en: ni(n)dhak dhusaT haraamakhor Thag dhes Thaga(n)dhaa |

en.bdb: I am a slanderer, knave, venal and a swindler who goes on cheating the whole world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਮਦੁ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਕਰੰਦਾ ।
verses.translit_en: kaam krodh madh lobh moh aha(n)kaar kara(n)dhaa |

en.bdb: I feel proud of my sexual urges, anger, greed, infatuations and other intoxications.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਵਾਸਘਾਤੀ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਨ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਨ ਰਖੰਦਾ ।
verses.translit_en: bisavaasaghaatee akirataghan mai ko na rakha(n)dhaa |

en.bdb: I am treacherous and ungrateful; none likes to keep me with him. Remember,
0 singing disciple! that the true Guru, alone is competent to grant pardon (for your sins).
